build_classifier_model: build a RepLKNet-31B image classifier model using mmpretrain build_classifier
run_model_inspection: run the script to print all state dict keys of the RepLKNet-31B model
configure_backbone: configure a RepLKNet backbone with arch 31B and out_indices 3 for image classification
configure_classification_head: configure a LinearClsHead with 1000 classes and CrossEntropyLoss for ImageNet classification
configure_neck: configure a GlobalAveragePooling neck layer for the RepLKNet-31B image classifier model
